newsitem.title: USA: Somatogen says Lilly ends support of rHb1.1.
newsitem.headline: Somatogen says Lilly ends support of rHb1.1.

text.p: Somatogen Inc said Thursday that Eli Lilly and Co has decided to discontinue support for rHb1.1 under their current agreement.

The company said the decision entitles it to receive certain termination payments. However, Lilly has expressed an interest in exploring restructuring the collaboration with respect to other indications of rHb1.1 and future generations of Somatogen's recombinant hemoglobin technology, said the company.
Somatogen said it intends to pursue discussions with Lilly and other potential corporate partners.

The company also said it plans to proceed with a cardiopulmonary bypass study of rHb1.1, which is scheduled to begin shortly. The current intraoperative clinical study of rHb1.1 being conducted by Lilly will be discontinued and Somatogen said it is assessing how to proceed with this indication. The Phase I clinical trials of rHb1.1 in hematopoiesis will continue.

Somatogen is a biopharmaceutical company engaged in the development and commercialization of genetically engineered recombinant human hemoglobin-based products. rHb1.1 is Somatogen's lead recombinant hemoglobin compound.
